name: Mississippi FMC Championship 2026
information:
This competition is supported by Southern Cubing LLC. To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).

This competition will determine the 2026 FMC State Champion for the [2026 Mississipi Championship](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MississippiChampionship2026)
